title: Schemadiff op registry
description: Single source of truth for the schemadiff op table: which ops exist and their execution phase, destructiveness, inverse op, and the DDL dialects the generator targets. `genprotocol ops` emits this table into BOTH the Go engine (go/pkg/schemadiff/ops_gen.go) and the Rust engine (rust/crates/schema-diff/src/ops_gen.rs) so the registry cannot drift between the two languages. The op *membership* (the ids below) is separately drift-checked by `genprotocol check` against `SchemaDiffOp` in metadata.json; this file owns the per-op properties (phase/destructive/inverse/dialects) that check does not cover. Values MUST match the engines' current behavior — the shared vector corpus (test/schema-diff-vectors) is the regression guard.
